purpose: Computer-side inventory of the governed research available to Katie's chats, organized by layer with privacy-safe last-edit timestamps.

timestamp_semantics.modified_at: Filesystem modification time in UTC. It is a recency and routing signal, not proof that a conclusion, evidence cutoff or authority state changed.
timestamp_semantics.latest_computer_edit_at: Latest modified_at among the materials attached to that package.

layers.label: Research packages
layers.meaning: Stable research identities with question, finding, evidence cutoff and relationships.

layers.label: Package material memberships
layers.meaning: Material-to-package memberships; one material may belong to several packages.

layers.label: Distinct computer-side materials
layers.meaning: Deduplicated safe inventory records with file state, role, custody layer and modification time.

layers.label: Public readings
layers.meaning: Materials with readable public editions or views.

layers.label: Private-library metadata
layers.meaning: Known materials whose names, roles and states may route research, while contents remain private.

layers.label: Connected research context
layers.meaning: Cross-package story and family structure for questions that span packages.

layers.label: Read-only shared brain API
layers.meaning: Bootstrap, OpenAPI, package index, package manifests, package interior inventory, material inventory and activity inventory.
